Command.Name: ReadEJByTraderSystemInvNum_JSON
Command.FPOperation: Read Electronic Journal Report by Trader System Invoice Number (Single Invoice) in the JSON format. The number of bytes equal to Length for JSON data must be read subsequently.

Arg.Name: OptionTraderSystemReportFormat
Arg.Desc: 1 character with value - 'S' - Detailed EJ - 's' - Brief EJ

Arg.Name: TraderSystemInvNum
Arg.Desc: 15 symbols for trader system invoice number
